Hon’ble Manoj K. Tiwari, J.
Mr. Ashish Joshi, Advocate for the 
petitioner.
Mr. Vinod Nautiyal, Deputy Advocate 
General for the State of Uttarakhand. 
Heard learned counsel for the parties.
Rejoinder affidavits are taken on record. 
The misc. applications, made therefor, stand 
disposed of.
On the oral prayer, learned counsel for 
the petitioner is permitted to implead Union of 
India, through Secretary, Ministry of Labour & 
Rehabilitation, Government of India, New 
Delhi, as party respondent. 
Petitioner to produce amended memo of 
parties in the Registry, within 24 hours.
Newly impleaded respondent shall be 
served through office of Assistant Solicitor 
General, within 48 hours. 
Newly impleaded respondent shall file 
counter affidavit within six weeks.
List this matter in the first week of March, 
2021.
Interim order, if any, to continue till then. 
 (Manoj K. Tiwari, J.) 
Arpan 04.01.2021
